This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Oral Reports: Events, part of Strand 15 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and imagination: It is enhanced as the learner reviews and orders activities taking place outside the classroom.
